scripts.dev: npm run start:dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.start: npm run start:prod --workspace=backend & npm run start --workspace=frontend
scripts.test:permissions: npm run build --workspace=backend && node --test tests/permissions-api.test.mjs && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=frontend/tsconfig.json node --import tsx --test tests/permissions-ui.test.tsx
